The Banks rebrand received accolades from four leading industry programs: the Brandies, the MUSE Awards, the Transform Awards, and the Davey Awards. When we introduced our new brand last year, it marked an important step in our journey to strengthen the ways we serve our customers and communities, Carter Bank President Brad Langs said. Seeing that work and progress recognized is both humbling and energizing. This achievement belongs to our entire Carter team, whose dedication and belief in our future made this possible.
